_meta: 중국어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱·한국어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 참고 음성은 VoxCPM2(설명 instruct 는 영어), 문장은 MOSS-TTS(language Chinese). PC 출력은 out/ref_zh/·out/zh/ (다른 언어와 섞이지 않게).
base_text: 今天下午有个会，我想先把资料准备好。结束以后一起去吃晚饭吗？

am.desc: A young man in his twenties speaking standard Mandarin, clear and gentle voice

af.desc: A young woman in her twenties speaking standard Mandarin, clear and soft voice

xiaoli.desc: A Chinese woman in her mid twenties, bright, quick and lively voice, Beijing Mandarin

haoran.desc: A Chinese man in his mid twenties, relaxed, warm and slightly deep voice

yue.desc: A Chinese woman in her late twenties, calm, confident and slightly low voice

dashu.desc: A Chinese man in his fifties, loud, hearty and rough-edged voice

fangdong.desc: A Chinese woman in her fifties, brisk, firm and businesslike voice

ayi.desc: A Chinese woman in her fifties, warm, chatty and motherly voice

dianyuan.desc: A young Chinese woman in her twenties, polite, even and professional clerk voice

fuwuyuan.desc: A young Chinese man in his twenties, polite, quick and friendly waiter voice

xiaoge.desc: A young Chinese man around twenty, energetic, hurried and cheerful voice

siji.desc: A Chinese man in his forties, steady, dry and talkative voice

laoban.desc: A Chinese man in his forties, confident, warm and a little loud voice

mom.desc: A Chinese woman in her early fifties, warm, brisk and motherly voice

man_y.desc: A Chinese man around twenty, natural and clear voice

man_m.desc: A Chinese man in his forties, steady and calm voice

man_o.desc: A Chinese man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice

woman_y.desc: A Chinese woman around twenty, natural and clear voice

woman_m.desc: A Chinese woman in her forties, composed and kind voice

woman_o.desc: A Chinese woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice

kid.desc: A Chinese child around eight years old, small and bright voice

announce.desc: A clear, even female announcer voice, like a subway or store announcement

robot.desc: A flat synthetic machine voice, like a kiosk or payment terminal

neutral.ref: 今天下午有个会，我想先把资料准备好。

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff
polite.ref: 您好，欢迎光临。您点的菜来了，请慢用。

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite
stiff.ref: 今天非常感谢您抽时间。我会努力的，请多多关照。

cheerful.ref: 哎，你来啦！今天天气真好，心情也特别好。

amused.ref: 哈哈，太好笑了。行，就这个感觉，咱们继续。

teasing.ref: 哟，这是什么表情呀？来，老实说，我谁都不告诉。

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud
excited.ref: 成了！我说出来了！我自己都吓了一跳，真的太谢谢你了！

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps
surprised.ref: 啊？真的吗？等一下，你这是什么意思？

shout.instruct: surprised and loud, an exaggerated comic retort
shout.ref: 什么？现在？你突然这么说我怎么办啊！

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond
tsukkomi.ref: 不是，我不是说这个！你怎么在这儿来这一套啊，真是。

annoyed.ref: 哎，真是的。又说这个？别说了行不行。

sad.ref: 就是……有点累了。没事的，你别担心我。

worried.ref: 你没事吧？是不是哪儿不舒服？要不要去医院看看？

flustered.ref: 哎，那个，我，等一下……我不知道该怎么说……

shy.ref: 嗯……那个……我也喜欢。所以……我们一起去吧。

gentle.ref: 没事的，慢慢来。我就在你旁边。
